promise: Generate images through one provider interface while preserving explicit feature requirements.
audience: Agents and people needing image generation from a stable CLI or MCP tool.
trigger: Generate or edit an image through an explicitly configured provider.

modes.name: Select
modes.output: A qualified provider recommendation or a precise capability failure.

modes.name: Generate
modes.when: The input and provider access are available.
modes.output: Provider-produced image bytes, paths and metadata.

modes.name: Integrate
modes.when: An agent host needs the interface.
modes.output: Installed MCP/CLI entry points and verified namespace compatibility.

examples.title: Fictional provider requirement
examples.brief: Inspect Imagen Provider’s installed help and MCP schema. Prepare a fictional packaging-image request that requires a reference image and an explicit output path. Explain which configured provider can meet it or what setup is missing. Do not make a paid generation call during this inspection.
examples.before: A missing provider silently drops the reference requirement.
examples.after: The selector either picks the available capable provider or stops with a setup error.
examples.why: Provider availability must not erase a requested feature.

boundaries: Provider invocation can cost money and requires an approved environment credential. Selector/mock tests do not generate images.
The parked video-mcp stub is retained separately as reference; it is not advertised as a functioning video provider.
Server defaults to environment-only configuration; IMAGEN_MCP_CONFIG_PROFILE=local explicitly enables the retained dotenv setup profile.

sources.role: Retained native owner implementation, import/CLI interfaces and complete source history.

consolidation: Public family repository name changes independently from stable native package/CLI/import identity.
No forced portable coaching wrapper; ordinary execution stays directly installable.
Upstream0.5.0 distribution/Smart Tool rename retained: imagen; MCP command/import remains imagen-mcp/imagen_mcp.
publication_status: Installation and evidence scopes are documented below.

marketing.headline: Generate the image without losing the requirements.
marketing.lead: For agents and developers adding image generation. Imagen Provider exposes one library, CLI and MCP interface, qualifies the configured provider against requested features and returns image paths and metadata through the same integration.

benefits.title: Keep the brief intact
benefits.body: A required feature, such as a reference image, must remain a requirement when the provider is selected.

benefits.title: Reuse one integration
benefits.body: Call the stable native interface from an agent host or from Python while provider adapters handle the differences.

benefits.title: Get an actionable setup failure
benefits.body: When no configured provider can satisfy the request, stop with a clear capability or configuration error.

walkthrough.title: Install and inspect
walkthrough.detail: Install the native package in a virtual environment and inspect imagen --help or the MCP tool schema.

walkthrough.title: Configure the provider
walkthrough.detail: Supply approved credentials through environment variables; the default profile does not search for dotenv files.

walkthrough.title: Submit an explicit request
walkthrough.detail: Set the image requirements and output path, then inspect the returned provider metadata and generated asset.

use_when: An agent needs an MCP image tool with explicit provider requirements.
An application needs generation or editing behind a stable Python interface.
A missing feature must fail clearly instead of being dropped.
not_for: A video provider; the older video stub is not a functioning capability.
marketing.quickstart_prompt: Inspect Imagen Provider’s installed help and MCP schema. Prepare a fictional packaging-image request that requires a reference image and an explicit output path. Explain which configured provider can meet it or what setup is missing. Do not make a paid generation call during this inspection.
marketing.output_preview:
Request
  task: fictional packaging mockup
  required feature: reference-image support
  output: caller-selected image path

Selection
  capable configured provider → submit explicit request
  no capable configured provider → setup/capability error

Result after generation: image bytes or path plus provider metadata
marketing.example_note: Fictional request and routing outline. No image was generated and no provider was invoked for this example.
install_notes: Native distribution: imagen; command: imagen; MCP entry point: python -m imagen_mcp.
Generation needs an approved OpenAI or Gemini credential and may incur provider charges.
The default config reads environment variables only. IMAGEN_MCP_CONFIG_PROFILE=local explicitly opts into the retained dotenv profile.
The shown virtual-environment commands use macOS/Linux paths; on Windows, use the corresponding .venv\Scripts executables.
marketing.proof_summary: Native provider/configuration tests and a clean-wheel MCP initialize/list-tools check passed with keys empty. Those checks establish integration behavior; generated image quality needs an actual reviewed output.
marketing.next_step: Install in a virtual environment, inspect the tool schema and configure only the provider your request needs.
